auth.note: Request a key from the operator (tabron@tabronmerryhill.com). Calls without a valid key receive 401. The key is checked against the AGENT_API_KEY env var; when unset, no key is accepted.

capabilities.description: Submit a readiness-assessment verdict for an owner-led business's workflow. The submission creates a record in Business Systems Requests with Status Queued — a human reviews it before anything is sold or scheduled. Use this when an agent has assessed a workflow and wants to hand the verdict into Readable's pipeline.

errors.meaning: Invalid input: missing required field, bad email format, or malformed JSON.
Intake backend unreachable or rejected the submission; safe to retry once.

capabilities.idempotency: idempotency_key is accepted but v1 does not deduplicate. Do not retry blindly; a retried call may create a second record.

contact_email.description: Business contact email. Must be a valid email address.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Accepted but not enforced in v1.

recommended_intervention.description: The smallest test or next step Readable should propose.

verdict.description: Assessment verdict, e.g. 'Ready', 'Not ready', 'Ready with conditions'.

workflow_description.description: The workflow that was assessed, in plain language.

capabilities.name: submit_assessment_request

record_id.description: Airtable record id of the created Business Systems Request, or null.

description: Readable's agent gate. AI agents submit readiness-assessment verdicts here; every submission lands in Business Systems Requests with Status Queued for human review. Humans hold the irreversible calls: nothing is sold, scheduled, or acted on without human review.
verification: Every submission creates a record in Business Systems Requests (Status Queued). The Next Action field carries the verdict, score, and recommended intervention verbatim, and the record title is 'Readiness Assessment — {business} — {date}'. These records are the audit trail for the station and the seed volume for Readable Evals.
